note: Price alerts checked at every monitor slot. One entry per stock: symbol (Yahoo format: US plain, UK with .L), below and/or above (in the quote currency: pence for .L shares, as Trading 212 shows them), optional name and note. Example: { "symbol": "HSBA.L", "name": "HSBC", "below": 1000, "note": "second tranche" }. Each level alerts once, then re-arms after the price moves 3% back.
